note: Behaviour definitions for the moba scenario. behaviour(name, trigger, action, param=, ability=)
answer_attack and idle_attack were attack_nearest records; that action is gone. Their Lua equivalent is
scenarios/moba/targeting.lua: on_attacked strikes the nearest enemy in reach when a unit is hit; on_behaviour
